stories.name: Dryad Militant
stories.intro: A dryad in bark armour guards a grove against Izzet progress. Spells cast near her crumble to dust. She sees a stranger and raises her spear.
stories.win: She lowers the spear and agrees to guard you instead. She is yours now.
stories.lose: The spear's butt catches you in the ribs.
stories.flee: You back out of the grove, and she lets you go.

stories.name: Centaur Healer
stories.intro: A centaur instructor from the Kasarna grounds is drilling students in the square. She mistakes you for one of them. The lesson starts now.
stories.win: She laughs, binds your cuts, and offers to travel with you. She is yours now.
stories.lose: You fail the lesson, and she patches you up before sending you off.
stories.flee: You slip away before the next drill.

stories.name: Selesnya Charm
stories.title: A gift from the Conclave
stories.text: A Selesnya knight-errant sits by a fountain, weaving charms from grass and silver wire. Each charm, she says, answers a different need. She offers to make one for you.

outcome.text: She listens, then ties the charm to your wrist.

choices.text: Offer to help the Conclave in return

outcome.text: She smiles and gives you the charm and a blessing.
She sets down the wire and draws her sword.

huge_success.text: You win the bout, and she gives you the charm and her purse.

success.text: She concedes the bout and hands you the charm.

failure.text: She disarms you and goes back to her weaving.

huge_failure.text: She knocks you into the fountain, and your supplies go with you.

stories.name: Growing Ranks
stories.title: The Conclave asks
stories.text: A Selesnya envoy finds you at a crossroads, holding a seed in cupped hands. Trostani wants an army that can withstand the Izzet. The seed will grow it, if someone plants it in Conclave ground and defends the sapling.

outcome.text: The envoy gives you the seed and sends word to Vitu-Ghazi to expect you.

choices.text: Ask what the Conclave will pay

outcome.text: The envoy adds a pouch of coin to the seed and points you to Vitu-Ghazi.
The envoy bows and waits at the crossroads in case you return.

stories.name: Selesnya Guildgate
stories.text: A gate of living branches stands open at the edge of a Selesnya district, flowers turning to greet you. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
